verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents first-party connections for payments (Stripe, with automated revenue recognition) and for spend and banking-style accounts (Brex, Ramp), and it reconciles bank and card accounts against the ledger. Payroll appears only as data the ledger and forecasts use; no payroll-system integration is named. Missing for 10: a documented payroll integration, an explicit list of supported bank-feed connections, details on automatic sync behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: 3 min to reconcile revenue When you connect Stripe with Puzzle
